mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 15 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 16, low 8.

OVL UÇK warned that street protests could erupt if the law on specialized housing continues to be delayed, saying the ongoing amendments risk sparking demonstrations.

Apple announced that production of the standard iPhone 18 and the iPhone Air 2 is scheduled to start in the spring, following the September launch of the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and iPhone Duo.

A video from the APEC summit shows U.S. President Donald Trump with his eyes closed, appearing to fall asleep while Chinese President Xi Jinping was speaking.

Real Madrid have welcomed back midfielders Bernardo Silva and Aurélien Tchouaméni to training ahead of their upcoming La Liga clash with Celta Vigo.

Vintage Modern unveiled a new Ford Mustang Fastback that blends the classic 1967 Shelby GT500 styling with a modern 840-horsepower powertrain.
